text:
maya (partnerships): Quick heads-up — QuantumCore signed the NDA last night. They want a short preview run next Tue-Wed. Proposed scope: perf microbench (p50/p95), throughput/cost with batching, and KV cache impact. Need owners + checklist.

aj (eng): I can own runtime config and kernel selection. Need model tar + tokenization script from them.

lin (eng-ml): I'll prepare the eval prompts and quality checks (smoke set). Metrics: ppl + a small task-based set.

elena (pm): Partner asked about press but we should hold off — no public announcements until MOU. I'll own the MOU step.

raj (infra): I'll provision a private cluster in their region (VPC peered). Need partner SSH key + S3 path. @devops-bot can you kick off infra playbook?

devops-bot: Provision job queued: playbook=infra/preview/quantumcore job_id=4821 ETA=18h. Logs -> https://internal.ci/jobs/4821 :gear: 

simon (QuantumCore): Thanks — I'll upload model artifacts to s3://qc-preview/models/ by EOD Mon and push our perf harness (Go) there too. We can provide a dockerfile. Any constraints on runtime?

aj (eng): We prefer containerd. If you send Dockerfile we can adapt. Also include expected tokenization script and a small sample dataset.

maya (partnerships): NDA checklist: legal confirmed redacted-PII clause. @elena can you confirm we can publish anonymized graphs post-MOU?

elena (pm): Confirmed — partner approval required but OK in principle. I'll add MOU approval step to timeline.

lin (eng-ml): Benchmark run snippet for the harness (for the ops handoff):

```
# run harness
./qc_harness --model /mnt/models/qc-v1 --batch-sizes 1,8,16 --seq-lens 32,512 --warmup 200 --measure p50,p95,throughput
```

Please output CSV to /benchmarks/quantumcore/run-<date>.csv and include raw logs.

aj (eng): Also include toggles: KV prefix caching on/off and quantized int8 profile for comparison. Use seed=42 for deterministic generation where applicable.

maya (partnerships): Next steps: 1) Simon uploads artifacts by Mon EOD; 2) Raj provisions infra (in progress); 3) Run bench Tue-Wed; 4) Sync Thu for readout + feedback loop. Any blockers?

simon (QuantumCore): No blockers from our side. One request: can you run an 8k-token sequence once? We can provide synthetic data for that.

lin (eng-ml): 8k sequences will need memory adjustments and possibly different kernel selection. We'll run a lite test first.

raj (infra): I'll test 8k on a smaller node to check OOM risk. If it fails we'll fallback to 2k and note it in the readout.

maya (partnerships): Perfect. I'll send a calendar invite and create the readout template (bench results + notes + partner feedback loop). :calendar: Thanks all!

simon (QuantumCore): Great — looking forward. I'll ping here when upload is done. :thumbsup:
